g.text: Whole-cohort generation: every constructor and all three fixed seeds
Top: HAALSI (n=4,394); bottom: Turkana (n=397, qualified holdout). Dots / short lines: three synthetic draws, not confidence intervals.
Dark line: measured-sample estimate; shading: HC3 working sensitivity interval (unweighted; no population or transport coverage).
